_doc: A48. units_holdout.json was mined and never cleaned, and 16 of its 26 records carry a NAME that is not a quantity -- section headings ('Strategy'), worked-example titles ('Curiosity Rover'), the formula itself ('V=B*l*v_d'), and seven literal '(from worked example)'. Every arm builds its question with quantity_surface(), which is the record's NAME, so those produce items asking for nothing: 'What is (from worked example)?', labelled expect:answer. DECLARED, not pattern-matched, because a chain of heuristics over names is the quantity_range() mistake -- see the project log. Each entry is AUTHORED BY READING the formula and its units and is written to be read: a wrong name here is as damaging as a wrong record. A record with no entry here and an unusable mined name is DROPPED and listed on every build.

L=((v)/(4*f_1)).name: length of a closed tube from its fundamental frequency
L=((v)/(4*f_1)).why: L = v/(4*f_1) is the quarter-wavelength resonator; store_clean.json carries this exact name for the same relation. Mined name was 'Strategy'.

a=((v_c)/(t_1)).name: acceleration from a speed reached in a given time
a=((v_c)/(t_1)).why: a:m/s^2 from v_c:m/s over t_1:s. Mined name was '(from worked example)'.

v=r*omega.name: tangential speed
v=r*omega.why: Mined name was 'Tangential speed:' -- the trailing colon is a MathML heading artefact. No judgement, punctuation only.

v_CM=r*omega.name: speed of the centre of mass of a rolling object
v_CM=r*omega.why: Rolling without slipping, v_CM = r*omega. Mined name was 'Curiosity Rover', the worked example's subject.

v=lambda*f.name: wave speed
v=lambda*f.why: CORRECTS A PHYSICS ERROR: the mined name was 'speed of light'. v = lambda*f is the general wave relation and holds for any wave, not only light.

x_2=v*t_2.name: distance travelled at constant speed
x_2=v*t_2.why: x:m from v:m/s and t:s. Mined name was '(from worked example)'.

lambda=lambda_0/n.name: wavelength in a medium
lambda=lambda_0/n.why: lambda_0 is the vacuum wavelength, n the refractive index (unit 1). Mined name was the section title 'Measuring the Refractive Index of a Gas'.

F=((Delta_p)/(Delta_t)).name: average force from a change in momentum
F=((Delta_p)/(Delta_t)).why: F:N = Delta_p:kg*m/s over Delta_t:s -- the impulse-momentum theorem. Mined name was the worked-example title 'Calculating Force: Venus Williams' Tennis Serve'.

v_w=f*lambda.name: wave speed from frequency and wavelength
v_w=f*lambda.why: Same relation as v=lambda*f with the wave-speed symbol. Mined name was 'Strategy FOR (B)'.

F=m*g.name: weight
F=m*g.why: F:N = m:kg * g:m/s^2. Mined name was '(from worked example)'.

V=B*l*v_d.name: motional emf
V=B*l*v_d.why: V:V = B:T * l:m * v:m/s is the motional emf of a rod moving through a field. The mined 'name' was the formula string itself.

dropped.d_1=((2*A)/(d_2)): NON-PHYSICS. A = (1/2)*d_1*d_2 is the area of a kite from its diagonals. Its sibling `d_2 = 2A/d_1` was group 1 of the store cleaning's deletions for exactly this reason.
dropped.x_1=((3)/(2))*v_0*t: The 3/2 factor belongs to one worked example's setup, not to a general relation. Naming it would assert a relation that is not one.
dropped.F_app=F_x+F_y: A scalar sum of two force components is valid only in the worked example's geometry (two tow ropes whose perpendicular components cancel). A general name would misrepresent it.
dropped.r=r_1+r_2: AMBIGUOUS: all three are metres, so this is a sum of lengths -- radii, distances or segments. Nothing in the record distinguishes them.
dropped.lambda=((2*h*c)/(E_0)): The factor 2 is not the standard lambda = h*c/E. Without the source context I cannot say what relation this is, and naming it would assert physics I have not verified.
